managePayments.heading: Payments
managePayments.state.not_connected.title: Not set up yet
managePayments.state.not_connected.body: Takes about 10 minutes. You will need your bank account details and your ID card.
managePayments.state.requirements.title: Stripe needs your details
managePayments.state.requirements.body: Card payments will not work until Stripe receives your business and bank account details.
managePayments.state.pending.title: Connected — Stripe is checking your details
managePayments.state.pending.body: You do not need to do anything. Stripe is reviewing what you sent, and this page will update when they have finished checking.
managePayments.state.ready.title: Connected
managePayments.state.ready.body: Your Stripe account is connected and can take payments.
managePayments.state.restricted.title: Card payments are paused
managePayments.state.restricted.body: Stripe has paused card payments on your account until a problem is resolved.
managePayments.state.unsupported.title: Card payments cannot be used on this account
managePayments.state.unsupported.body: Stripe cannot switch on card payments here. Please contact us and we will sort it out with you.
managePayments.keyMismatch.title: The Stripe keys do not match
managePayments.keyMismatch.body: This site’s server is using the {server, select, live {live} other {test}} type of Stripe key while the browser was built with the {browser, select, live {live} other {test}} type of key. Card payments would fail when a customer tries to pay, so setting up Stripe is blocked until the two keys match.
managePayments.keyMismatch.fix: Both keys must be set for the same environment, and the site must be rebuilt afterwards — the public (publishable) key is put in at build time, while the secret key is read on every request.
managePayments.permission.title: Only the Food Truck’s owner can set up payments
managePayments.permission.body: Stripe is connected by the person whose bank account receives the money, so it must be set up from the account they are logged in to themselves. There is no problem with this Food Truck or with HatchGrab.
managePayments.config.keyMissingTitle: Card payments have not been configured yet
managePayments.config.fetchTitle: We could not check this Food Truck’s Stripe account
managePayments.config.keyMissing: {name} has not been set — the embedded components cannot load.
managePayments.online.heading: Online payments
managePayments.online.body: Customers pay by card when they order. The money goes straight into your own Stripe account — we never hold that money.
managePayments.online.feeLine: Stripe charges {fee} per payment for standard {region}. Other cards may cost more. HatchGrab’s own fee on online orders depends on your plan — see “Billing”.
managePayments.online.testMode: Test mode. Real payments cannot be taken yet.
managePayments.trialNote: Setting this up does not start your subscription or charge you anything today. It is how customers pay you — your plan is separate.
managePayments.admin.title: Viewing as the system admin
managePayments.admin.body: This Food Truck has not set up online payments. Only the owner can start it, from the account they are logged in to themselves — there is nothing to press here.
managePayments.toast.addDetails: Now please enter your details for Stripe
managePayments.onboarding.restricted: From here Stripe carries on — you will log in to Stripe and update the details it needs.
managePayments.onboarding.firstRun: From here Stripe carries on — you will log in to Stripe, then give your business and bank account details.
managePayments.details.title: Your Stripe details
managePayments.details.body: Change the bank account you receive money into, or update your business details and documents.
managePayments.walkUp.heading: Walk-up payments
managePayments.walkUp.body: How you take money at the Food Truck. HatchGrab charges no platform fee on walk-up orders, whichever one you choose.
managePayments.walkUp.ownTerminalHelp: Zettle, Square or whatever you are already using. Nothing to set up — only your provider’s own fees.
managePayments.walkUp.hatchgrabHelp: Uses the same Stripe connection as your online payments — a card reader, or contactless payment straight from your phone or tablet.
managePayments.walkUp.hatchgrabFees: {fee} per payment for {region}, plus {surcharge} for contactless taken on a phone or tablet. Other cards may cost more.
manageCharges.heading: Tax, tips and fees
manageCharges.rate.label: Sales tax rate
manageCharges.rate.hint: The rate you charge on every order. Customers see it added when they pay, on receipts and on kitchen tickets.
manageCharges.rate.regionDefault: Leave it empty to charge {label} at {rate}%, which is the rate on prepared food in {region}.
manageCharges.included.label: {label} included in your prices
manageCharges.included.hint: Your prices already include {label}. This rate only shows how much of each price is {label} on receipts and kitchen tickets — nothing is added when paying.
manageCharges.included.default: Leave it empty to use {rate}%, which is the {label} rate on hot food sold as takeaway in {country}.
manageCharges.tips.label: Tips
manageCharges.tips.hint: Customers who pay online by card can add a tip. All tips are yours.
manageCharges.fee.label: Online service fee
manageCharges.fee.hint: Added to online orders only. Never charged on “Pay at the truck” orders or walk-up orders. This money is yours.
manageCharges.fee.fixedAria: Fixed amount of the service fee
manageCharges.fee.example: Customers see it before paying, as a single line: “{label} {amount}”.
manageCharges.fee.hatchgrab: HatchGrab adds a {fee} service fee to your customers’ online orders. You do not pay it and cannot change it.
manageCharges.saveFailed: Could not save — please try again.
takingPayment.heading: Taking payment
takingPayment.intro: How your team records money for each order.
takingPayment.paidStepHelp: Adds a “Confirm” button when you add an order yourself, so you can place the order now and take payment later. Switch this on if you take phone orders or pre-orders.
takingPayment.paidStepNote: This setting only affects orders you add. It does not affect online orders.

manageWhatsApp.preview.title: Try it before connecting
manageWhatsApp.preview.intro: Please type a question the way a customer would ask, and see exactly what answer they would get. Nothing is sent to anyone.
manageWhatsApp.preview.noReplyWhy: That message looks like spam, a booking request or something unrelated, so the WhatsApp auto-reply stays quiet.
manageWhatsApp.preview.footnote: Replies are made by AI, differ slightly each time, and can occasionally be wrong.
manageWhatsApp.preview.failed: Could not make a preview right now.
manageWhatsApp.preview.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Please check your connection and try again.
manageWhatsApp.setup.popupHint: Can’t see the Facebook window? It may have been blocked. Please allow pop-ups for hatchgrab.com, then press “Start again”.
manageWhatsApp.notice.sdkUnavailable: WhatsApp setup cannot be used in this environment.
manageWhatsApp.notice.sdkBlocked: Meta’s login script could not load. The usual cause is an ad blocker or tracking protection.
manageWhatsApp.notice.setupFailed: Setup could not be completed. Nothing was changed.
manageWhatsApp.notice.metaError: Meta reported a problem during setup. Nothing was changed. Please try again, and contact us if it keeps happening.
manageWhatsApp.notice.closed: Setup was closed before it finished. Nothing was changed — please press “Set up” to try again.
manageWhatsApp.notice.disconnectedUnreac: WhatsApp is disconnected. We could not reach Meta to remove access. Please remove HatchGrab in WhatsApp Business → Settings → Account → Business Platform.
manageWhatsApp.notice.disconnected: WhatsApp is disconnected. WhatsApp auto-replies have stopped.
manageWhatsApp.card.title: WhatsApp auto-replies
manageWhatsApp.card.description: Answer customers’ questions automatically on your social media, using your menu and schedule.
manageWhatsApp.card.popupInstruction: A Facebook window will open to connect your WhatsApp Business account. If nothing appears, please allow pop-ups for hatchgrab.com in your browser, then press “Set up” again.
manageWhatsApp.card.switchedOff: WhatsApp auto-replies are switched off for your Food Truck.
manageWhatsApp.card.expiring: Your WhatsApp connection needs renewing soon. Please press “Reconnect” to keep WhatsApp auto-replies working.
manageWhatsApp.card.instagram: Automatic replies to direct messages (DM) on Instagram. Will need an Instagram account for business (professional).
manageWhatsApp.card.messenger: Automatic replies on Facebook Messenger. Will need a Facebook page (Facebook Page).
manageWhatsApp.blocked.title: Your replies are not being delivered
manageWhatsApp.blocked.body: WhatsApp is refusing to send your automatic replies because of a billing problem on your WhatsApp Business account. Customers can still message you and you still see everything they send — but they are not getting a reply.
manageWhatsApp.blocked.fix: You pay WhatsApp directly for these messages, so this is fixed in WhatsApp Manager. <link>Check your payment method</link>
manageWhatsApp.limit.heading: WhatsApp auto-replies
manageWhatsApp.limit.label: Monthly limit
manageWhatsApp.limit.usage: {used, number} of {limit, number} used · resets on {date}
manageWhatsApp.limit.perCustomer: Replies up to {n} times to one customer within 24 hours, then sends one message saying you will reply personally.
manageWhatsApp.limit.emailAt: Replies pause when they reach your limit. We will email you at 80% and 100%.
manageWhatsApp.billing.heading: Billing
manageWhatsApp.billing.summary: Meta, not HatchGrab, charges your WhatsApp account for replies. From {from} the first {free, number} replies a month are free. Correct as of {checked}. Please check <link>Meta’s pricing</link> for changes.
manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesTitle: Meta is the one that charges for WhatsApp replies, not HatchGrab.
manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesBody: Each reply HatchGrab sends for you is charged by Meta to your WhatsApp Business account. From {from}, Meta gives {free, number} free replies a month per number; after that, each reply is charged at Meta’s rate. Replies you send yourself from the WhatsApp Business app are not charged. Meta sets these prices and may change them. <link>See Meta’s pricing</link>
manageWhatsApp.billing.addPaymentInManag: Add a payment method in WhatsApp Manager
manageWhatsApp.billing.aboveMissing: Your limit is above Meta’s {free, number} free replies. Without a payment method, Meta will stop all replies once those free replies are used up.
manageWhatsApp.billing.aboveGeneral: Your limit is above Meta’s {free, number} free replies. Replies beyond that need a payment method on your WhatsApp account; without one, Meta stops all replies once the free ones are used up.
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.title: Disconnect WhatsApp?
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.body: WhatsApp auto-replies stop at once and HatchGrab loses access to your WhatsApp account. Your number keeps working in the WhatsApp Business app. To remove HatchGrab completely, please also open WhatsApp Business → Settings → Account → Business Platform.
manageWhatsApp.signup.partial: We linked your WhatsApp Business account but could not complete the connection. Nothing is wrong on your side — please contact us and we will finish it for you.
manageWhatsApp.signup.noNumber: Your WhatsApp Business account is linked, but no phone number was sent back. Please press “Reconnect” and finish the phone number step.
manageWhatsApp.signup.needsRegistering: Your account is linked, but this number needs us to register it first before replies can start. Please contact support — your setup is already saved, do not do it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.registerRefused: Your account is linked but Meta would not register this number. Your setup is already saved — please contact support instead of doing it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.deliveryRefused: Your account is linked but Meta would not switch on message delivery. Your setup is already saved — please contact support instead of doing it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.numberTaken: That WhatsApp number is already connected to another HatchGrab account. One number can only answer for one Food Truck. Please contact support and we will move it across.
manageWhatsApp.signup.saveIncomplete: Almost there — we could not finish saving. Your setup is already saved; please contact support instead of doing it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.connected: WhatsApp is connected. WhatsApp auto-replies will start answering messages sent to this number.
customDomain.card.title: Put your schedule on your website
customDomain.card.create: We create a page at <addr>{address}</addr> that shows your schedule.
customDomain.card.justLive: {address} is now working. Please have a look at it, then tell us below that it is right.
customDomain.waiting.title: We are waiting for {address}
customDomain.waiting.bodySince: You set this up on {date}. New web addresses usually start working within a few minutes, and occasionally take up to 24 hours before everyone can reach them — you do not need to do anything during that time. If someone else was adding the line for you, it is worth checking that they did it.
customDomain.waiting.body: New web addresses usually start working within a few minutes, and occasionally take up to 24 hours before everyone can reach them — you do not need to do anything during that time. If someone else was adding the line for you, it is worth checking that they did it.
customDomain.ready.title: {address} is now working
customDomain.ready.body: Please have a look at it, then tell us it is right in your settings.
customDomain.confirm.heading: Please have a look, then tell us it is right
customDomain.confirm.checkTimes: Please check the dates and times look right.
customDomain.confirm.problemLine: Please tell us what you are seeing and we will look into it.
customDomain.confirmed.heading: Thank you — we have noted it all.
customDomain.confirmed.body: There is nothing else to do.
customDomain.turnOff.heading: Switch off your own web address?
customDomain.turnOff.carriesOn: This address keeps working just as it is, and is where your QR code sends people:
customDomain.turnOff.reAdd: If you will set it up again later, leave the line you added at your web address company. If not, ask them to remove it.
customDomain.turnOff.failed: We could not switch it off right now. Nothing has changed — your address is still working. Please try again shortly.
customDomain.wizard.resumeFailedTitle: We could not load your setup.
customDomain.wizard.resumeFailedBody: Nothing has changed. Please try again shortly.
customDomain.address.intro: Your schedule gets its own web address.
customDomain.address.question: What is your web address?
customDomain.address.hint: The address people already use to find you.
customDomain.address.noChange: Your website does not change — you just add a link to the new address.
customDomain.address.notSetUp: We have not set this up.
customDomain.address.restricted: Whoever looks after your web address has to allow us to set up the padlock — the small lock customers see next to the address. Until they add us it will not appear, so we have stopped rather than leave you waiting for it. Please ask them to add us, then try again.
customDomain.address.blocked: Your web address currently blocks the padlock completely. Whoever looks after it has to allow it first before this can work. Please ask them to change that setting, then try again.
customDomain.address.elsewhere: Something already answers at that address. Please send the message on the next screen to whoever looks after it — they will know what to do.
customDomain.address.provider: Your web address is managed by {provider}. We will show you where to go.
customDomain.address.provisionFailed: We could not set up that address.
customDomain.address.couldNotBeSetUp: That address could not be set up.
customDomain.apex.empty: Please type the address you want to use.
customDomain.apex.not_a_domain: That does not look like a web address.
customDomain.apex.unparseable: We could not read that as a web address. Please check the spelling and try again.
customDomain.apex.apex: {host} is your whole website address. If you point it at us, your website is replaced by this page. Instead, put a word in front of it — for example events.{host}.
customDomain.apex.too_deep: That address has too many parts. Something like events.{domain} works best.
customDomain.record.addSomewhere: Add this where your web address is managed, and save.
customDomain.record.hintWord: Only this word, not the whole address.
customDomain.record.timing: It usually starts working within an hour, although it can take longer. You do not need to keep this page open.
customDomain.record.someoneElse: Does someone else look after your web address?
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.open: Open your web address, then “DNS” and “Records”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.add: Select “Add record”, then choose “CNAME” as the “Type”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.value: Put the second value below in “Target”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.proxy: Set “Proxy status” to “DNS only” — the cloud next to it must be grey, not orange.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.caveat: If the cloud stays orange, the padlock will never appear, and nothing will say why.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.open: Open your “Domain Portfolio” and choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.add: Select “Add New Record”, then choose “CNAME” from the “Type” menu.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.save: Leave “TTL” as it is and select “Save”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.caveat: If you added more than one at once, the button says “Save All Records”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.signIn: Log in to your “123 Reg Control Panel”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.manage: Next to “Domains”, select “Manage All”, then choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.123reg.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.value: Put the second value below in “Value”, and add a dot (.) to the end of it.
customDomain.providers.123reg.caveat: 123 Reg needs a dot (.) at the end of the second value, otherwise it will not work.
customDomain.providers.wix.open: Open “Domains”, then click the “Domain Actions” icon next to your web address.
customDomain.providers.wix.add: In the “CNAME (Aliases)” section, click “+ Add Record”, then click “Got it”.
customDomain.providers.wix.name: Put the first value below in “Host Name”.
customDomain.providers.wix.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.wix.save: Click “Save”, then click “Save Changes” in the pop-up.
customDomain.providers.wix.caveat: If your web address only points at Wix rather than being held there, Wix cannot make this change — whoever holds it has to.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.subject: One record to add for the schedule page of {truckName}
customDomain.instructionsEmail.introAt: We are putting the current schedule of {truckName} on {address}, and it needs one record added to our domain at {provider}.
